text: 10月12日，在第二十六届中国国际工业博览会开幕式上，“上海市加快发展新一代智能制造行动”正式启动。上海将实施四大工程、开展19项重点任务，推动人工智能与制造业深度融合，加快构建新一代智能制造体系。 目前，上海已培育2家国家领航级、28家国家卓越级智能工厂，数量多年位居全国城市第一，智能制造综合指数位居长三角城市榜首。上海智能制造系统集成产业规模超过600亿元，智能制造装备产值超过1500亿元，成为国内最大的智能制造系统集成和装备产业集聚区。
text_en: On October 12, at the opening ceremony of the 26th China International Industry Fair, the "Shanghai Action to Accelerate the Development of a New Generation of Smart Manufacturing" was officially launched. Shanghai will implement four major projects and carry out 19 key tasks to promote deep integration of artificial intelligence and manufacturing and accelerate the building of a new-generation smart manufacturing system. At present, Shanghai has cultivated 2 national lighthouse-level and 28 national excellence-level smart factories, ranking first among Chinese cities for many years, and its comprehensive smart manufacturing index ranks first among Yangtze River Delta cities. Shanghai's smart manufacturing system integration industry scale exceeds 60 billion yuan, and smart manufacturing equipment output value exceeds 150 billion yuan, making it China's largest cluster for smart manufacturing system integration and equipment industry.
